summary: Against the new base, the change is only the ThreadManager.events early snapshot: when a session is not open yet, its stored history is sent before the runtime opens. The live watch then sends a second snapshot that replaces the first. I reviewed this logic in earlier rounds and it is unchanged. The temp tests check the handoff, history arriving while instructions are still loading, and the missing-session error. They pass, and I accept the one coverage exemption.
